login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the account of your instance.

errors.invalid_credentials: Email address or password is incorrect.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.not_initialized: This instance is not set up yet. Finish the first-start wizard, then sign in.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.session_expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

home.title: Your console is ready
home.empty: Nothing to show yet. Your APIs, runs and settings will appear here.

statusDefault.warning: Output conforms, with a point to watch.
statusDefault.action_requise: An action from you is needed.
statusDefault.bloquee: The site refuses automated access; Scrapyomama stops.

reasons.escalated: A costlier method than usual was needed.
reasons.repaired: The strategy was repaired (v{a} to v{b}).
reasons.pagination_short: {n} of {m} requested pages read, without reaching the end of the list.
reasons.slow: Run {x} times longer than the median.
reasons.cost_anomaly: Run {x} times costlier than the median.
reasons.unavailable: The site is not responding. This is not a breakage.
reasons.reverted: Manual revert to v{a} by {name} on {date}.
reasons.reinvestigation_failed: The re-investigation found nothing conforming; the previous version is kept.
reasons.rate_limited: The site asks to slow down (429). Rate reduced from {a} to {b} requests per minute, address unchanged.
reasons.geo_restriction: Content unavailable from this country; trying with the proxy of the country allowed by the API.
reasons.blocked_by_protection: The site refuses automated access. Scrapyomama stops.
reasons.forbidden: The site refuses access to this address. The IP address does not change.
reasons.robots_disallowed: The site asks robots not to visit this page.
reasons.robots_unreachable: robots.txt is unreachable: as a precaution, nothing is collected.
reasons.payment_required: The site asks for a payment: {offer}.
reasons.session_device_bound: The session on {domain} is tied to your device and cannot be copied to the server.
reasons.challenge_in_tunnel: A check appeared in your browser. The run is paused.
reasons.account_limit: The platform flagged a limit on your account. No automatic retry.
reasons.session_owner_required: This API uses its owner's session.
reasons.llm_refused: The model refused the request; no automatic fallback.
reasons.repairing: Extraction broken; repair {n} of {m} in progress.
reasons.repair_exhausted: Repair budget exhausted; version v{a} kept.
reasons.not_found: The page no longer exists (404 or 410).

apiErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
apiErrors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
apiErrors.not_found: This resource does not exist or is not accessible.
apiErrors.forbidden: You do not have the rights for this action.
apiErrors.conflict: This action is not possible in the current state of the API.
apiErrors.invalid_input: The values entered do not match the input schema.
apiErrors.queue_full: The queue is full. Try again in a moment.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.caption: API catalog: name, execution, network, status and reason, last run, average cost, success rate and access

empty.title: Your catalog is ready to fill up
empty.description: No API yet. Describe what you want to get: Scrapyomama investigates.

noMatch.title: No API matches
noMatch.description: Change or remove filters to see more results.

detail.title: API page
detail.metadataOnly: You see the metadata of this API (state, cost, duration): its content belongs to another user.

what.title: What happened
what.robots: This site asks robots not to visit this page. Scrapyomama respects this rule.
what.forbidden: The site refuses access to this address. The IP address does not change after a refusal. Check your access rights or contact the publisher.

why.title: Why we stop
why.protection: This is the site's decision. Scrapyomama does not answer in place of a person and does not change IP address after a refusal.
why.robots: This is the rule the site declares in its robots.txt file. Scrapyomama always respects it.
why.forbidden: This is the site's decision. Scrapyomama does not change IP address after a refusal.

todo.title: What you can do
todo.official: Look for an official API, an export or a partnership.
todo.contact: Write to the site's publisher, using the access request template below.
todo.later: Re-investigate later, if the site has changed.

request.template:
Hello,

I would like to access the data of {domain} in an automated way, while respecting your access rules. Is there an official API, an export or a partnership agreement?

Thank you in advance.

connect.title: Connect {domain}
connect.verify: The session shows up here as soon as the extension sends it (live update).

deviceBound.title: The session on {domain} cannot be copied to the server
deviceBound.button: Choose to run from my browser
deviceBound.verify: The extension state is updated live.

proxy.title: Add a proxy for {country}
proxy.verify: Use the Test button in the settings to check the proxy.

tunnelOffline.title: Your computer is not connected
tunnelOffline.verify: The connection state is updated live.

challenge.title: {domain} shows a verification in your browser; the run is stopped
challenge.text: Nothing was sent on this page and nothing will be. You can run again later; Scrapyomama never answers a verification.
challenge.verify: No automatic resume: only a new action from you starts a run.

secret.title: A stored key is unreadable
secret.verify: Use the Test button to check the new key.

accountLimit.title: {platform} flagged a limit on your account

launch.title: Run the API
launch.sideEffects: Running again can repeat side effects: sends, writes or actions already done by the previous run.
launch.jsonHint: The input schema has fields the form cannot display: enter the input as JSON.
launch.jsonInvalid: The JSON entered is not a valid object.

estimate.known: Usual cost: {cost}, median of {n} run | Usual cost: {cost}, median of {n} runs

schemas.invalid: The JSON entered is not a valid object.

confirm.title: Change the output schema?
confirm.consequence: This change triggers a re-investigation: the API goes back to investigating and new attempts are made, with their cost.

schemas.viewsHint: The displayed columns (views) are distinct from the output schema.

strategy.validated: Validated on {n} sample | Validated on {n} samples

revertConfirm.title: Go back to v{v}?
revertConfirm.consequence: The API goes to “To watch”, with the reason “manual revert to v{v}”. The next run uses this version.

diff.title: Comparison of v{from} and v{to}
diff.rawCaption: Raw diff between v{from} and v{to}

runsTab.retention: Runs kept {n} day by default | Runs kept {n} days by default

states.skipped_overlap: Skipped: a run is already in progress

runsTab.relaunchUnavailable: The input of this run cannot be read again. Run the API from the overview.

schedules.cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
schedules.inputHint: The dated variables today and yesterday are accepted between double braces.
schedules.inputInvalid: The JSON entered is not a valid object.
schedules.overlapLabel: If the previous run is not finished
schedules.onlyIfOnline: Only if the computer is connected
schedules.skipHint: A schedule does not call a site whose API is in error, action required or blocked.

accessTab.noReport: No access report for this API yet.

robotsStatuses.unreachable: Unreachable (as a precaution, nothing is collected)

accessTab.robotsAlways: robots.txt is always respected: no setting can ignore it.
accessTab.signalsHint: These signals are shown as data: they block nothing and are never passed to the model as instructions.
accessTab.policyFixed: The access policy is fixed: it cannot be changed from the console.

replay.title: Investigation replay
replay.retention: Events are kept 30 days and captures 7 days by default; captures are off by default in tunnel mode and behind a sign-in.
